# NEW 2026-11-18 fourth round D4 (settling reclaimed provinces, oe_trc_). Generated by gen_round4_reclaim.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Hardcoded hooks append to the existing handlers.
on_location_changed_owner = { on_actions = { oe_trc_owner_changed } }
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_trc_byz_pulse } }

# root = location, scope:loser = previous owner, scope:winner = new owner (can be null). A former province
# (gen_territory_outer.py) that passes to BYZ or one of its themes waits to be settled; a waiting location that passes
# to anyone else drops out. gen_territory_outer.py's own hook and its yearly check are not touched.
oe_trc_owner_changed = {
    trigger = { OR = { has_variable = oe_tw_former_province has_variable = oe_trc_pending has_variable = oe_trc_batch } }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { oe_trc_new_owner_byz = yes }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = oe_tw_former_province
                    NOT = { has_variable = oe_trc_pending }
                    NOT = { oe_trc_settled = yes }
                }
                set_variable = { name = oe_trc_pending value = var:oe_tw_former_province }
                c:BYZ ?= { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_trc_open } } set_variable = oe_trc_open } }
            }
        }
        else = {
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_pending } remove_variable = oe_trc_pending }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_batch } remove_variable = oe_trc_batch }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ, monthly, only while some land waits to be settled.
oe_trc_byz_pulse = {
    trigger = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no has_variable = oe_trc_open }
    effect = { oe_trc_byz_monthly = yes }
}
